summary: Petition seeking review of the Commission’s order dated 9.2.2021 in Petition No 328/MP/2018. NHPC Limited, NHPC Office Complex, Sector- 33, Faridabad-121003 (Haryana) **Review Petitioner** _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 1 of_ **_12_** _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 2 of_ **_12_** Petition No. 328/MP/2018 was filed by the Petitioner, NHPC Limited for recoupment of under-recovered energy charges due to shortfall in energy generation for reasons beyond the control during the year 2017-18, in respect of Sewa-II hydropower station (in short ‘the generating station’) under Regulation 31(6) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014 (hereinafter referred to as “the 2014 Tariff Regulations”) and the Commission vide order dated 9.2.2021 disposed of the same. Aggrieved thereby, the Review Petitioner, NHPC Limited has filed the Review Petition challenging the impugned order dated 9.2.2021 on the following grounds: 2. The Commission, after hearing the learned counsel for the Review Petitioner on ‘admission’ through virtual hearing on 20.7.2021, reserved its order on admissibility of the Review Petition. Based on the submissions of the Review Petitioner and the documents available on record, we proceed to dispose of the issues raised in the Review Petitions, as stated in the subsequent paragraphs. _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 3 of_ **_12_** |**Particulars**|**As per Petitioner **|**As per Commission **| |---|---|---| |A. Shortfall for reasons beyond the control of generating station|(-) 37.30 MU (Paragraph- 8 of Petition no 328/MP/ 2018)|(-) 37.30 MU as per paragraph 39 (a) of impugned order dated 9.2.2021.| |B. Shortfall for reasons within the control of generating station|10.19 MU (Paragraph-8 of Petition No. 348/MP/ 2018)|10.20 MU (+) 13.80 MU +**(-)** 3.60 MU as per paragraph 39 (b) of impugned order dated 9.2.2021.| |**C. Total shortfall(A+B)**|**(-) 27.11 MU**|**(-) 27.11 MU**| _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 4 of_ **_12_** _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 5 of_ **_12_** _41. In light of above deliberations, the Commission is of the view that the Petitioner shall be allowed to recover shortfall in energy charges in proportion to the energy shortfall which occurred due to reasons which were not under the control of the Petitioner i.e. 37.30 MU. However, the Petitioner by managing the reservoir level has managed to generate additional energy of 13.80 MU. The Petitioner has accounted this additional generation under the reasons which were under the control of the Petitioner, nevertheless same needs to be adjusted for arriving at the allowable recovery of energy charges. Accordingly, out of total shortfall of 27.11 MU, shortfall for reasons under the control of the Petitioner has been taken as 3.60 MU (due to Order in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 25 plant outages etc.) and shortfall for the reasons beyond the control of the Petitioner has been taken as 23.51 MU {27.11 MU - 3.60 MU}.”_ _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 6 of_ **_12_** _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 7 of_ **_12_** - 9.2.2021, the claim of the Review Petitioner that there has been double deduction of (-) 3.60 MU in paragraph 41 of the said order is misconceived. We, therefore, hold that there is no error apparent on the face of the order and the review sought on this ground is rejected. _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 8 of_ **_12_** _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 9 of_ **_12_** 12. The learned counsel for the Review Petitioner, during the hearing on 20.7.2021, _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 10 of_ **_12_** _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 11 of_ **_12_** submissions made in the original petition and seek review of the impugned order dated 9.2.2021. 15. As the findings of the Commission in the impugned order dated 9.2.2021 are based on the submissions of the parties, including the Review Petitioner, we find no reason to entertain the present revised submissions of the Review Petitioner for review the impugned order dated 9.2.2021. There is no error apparent on the face of the order and the review on this count stands rejected. _Order in Petition No. 14/RP/2021 in Petition No. 328/MP/2018 Page 12 of_ **_12_** CERC Website S.
